patch_notes:
🚀 MAJOR NEW FEATURES & EXPANSION:
• 30-Day Sculpting Challenge: A new daily progression system. Choose session goals (Anatomy, Portrait, Creature, etc.) or input custom tasks. The calendar visually tracks consistency (Blue = Active Today, Green = Completed).
• Analytical Skill Tree: AI now tracks your growth in 5 core categories: Gesture, Proportion, Anatomy, Planes, and Detail. The tree updates dynamically based on AI visual analysis.
• Omni-Voice Control: Advanced hands-free control. Trigger actions by saying: 'Sentinel...', 'Computer...', or 'System...'.
- Search: 'Search for...' – automatically launches AI Radar on the Ref Board.
- Analysis: 'Analyze this' or 'Check screen' – forces an immediate scan.
- Tools: 'Clear board' (removes drawings), 'Open report' (shows Ref Board), 'Start Pomodoro'.
- Safety: 'Stop' or 'Silence' – immediately kills TTS audio and clears the screen overlays.
• Artistic Brush Engine: Added professional brush size control for overpaints. Use [ and ] keys to adjust thickness in real-time.

🌐 REF BOARD & CONNECTIVITY:
• Pinterest & Web Drag-Drop: Direct integration with web browsers. Drag any image from Pinterest or Google directly onto the board. Sentinel now handles background networking to fetch high-res source files automatically.
• Smart Clipboard 2.0: Rewritten clipboard handling. Support for copying images, HTML fragments, and direct URLs. AI now auto-detects if the clipboard contains a link and offers to download it.
• View-Centric Spawning: New images now intelligently spawn in the center of your current viewport, preventing 'lost' images on large boards.
• Liquid Glass Overlay: New reactive UI blur effect that triggers when dragging files over the board, providing clear visual feedback for drop zones.

⚙️ WORKFLOW & INTERFACE:
• Alt + Drag Panning: Window movement is now bound to Alt + Left Mouse Button, freeing up the LMB for precise selection and drawing operations.
• Visual Monitor OSD: New large On-Screen Display indicator to show which monitor is currently being analyzed.
• Global Voice Expansion: Added 10+ new AI TTS languages (Polish, Chinese, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Korean, etc.) with full localized UI support.

🛠️ PERFORMANCE & BUG FIXES:
• Asynchronous Signal Bridge: Fixed a critical 'Cross-Thread' crash when adding network images to the UI. Implemented a robust Signal-Slot architecture for thread-safe board updates.
• Undo Macro Fix: Resolved a PyQt6 TypeError where clearing drawings would crash the application due to missing macro descriptions.
• Deep Session Recovery: Fixed 'save_dir' attribute errors and improved the logic for prompting session restoration on startup.
• Lazy Loading: Startup time drastically improved by loading heavy ML models (MediaPipe/Rembg) only when first used.
